svg.title: Load testing
svg.desc: A k6 stress test with an open model sends requests to the ticket API on a schedule and ramps the rate from 600 toward a 3,000 a second target while charts draw requests a second and checkout p99 latency. At 1,800 a second the seat hold query starts waiting on row locks and checkout p99 climbs to 6 seconds, found three weeks before the real sale.
svg.text: Ramp the load up until it breaks: at 1,800 a second, p99 hits 6 s.
